description: Shows the user a picture of the board right in the conversation, as the editor draws it, with a button that opens it in Perfboard Designer. Only in clients that show MCP Apps (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT); elsewhere the user sees nothing, so give them make_share_link's link too. The picture goes to the user, not to you: to look at the board yourself, use render_board.

name.description: The project's name, shown under the picture and in the editor. Defaults to the name it was given in new_project or came with from read_share_link.

project.description: The whole project file (through version 8), or its JSON text (see perfboard://docs/project-file). Give this or projectId. Preserve instanceId and optional requirements fields.

projectId.description: The id of a project kept here (from new_project, validate_project, edit_project or read_share_link), instead of sending the whole project.

name: show_board
title: Show board
